body:
Source-derived optimization proposal; no measured application, token, cost or memory gain is established. The linked published source fragments are byte-identical to inspected local `940fcf220e47d1975f757e76f0b3401691db9358`.

[src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs:90–101](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs#L90-L101) counts every successful first-pass callback. The old code then counts every type across the whole workspace and reserves that many entries ([src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs:108–121](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs#L108-L121)). In the second-pass callback, a duplicate returns without insertion at lines142–147; a nonduplicate performs exactly one push at lines153–157, after the capacity guard at148–150 ([src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs:123–159](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/blob/4f8f598c7935d0a5cdd4a5d5ba5b49d164ae2cfc/src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/private_layout.rs#L123-L159)). Thus unique inserted entries are bounded by the first-pass occurrence count, assuming unchanged traversal on immutable inputs.

Candidate capacity: `min(count, total_workspace_types)`. Preserve the existing `names::first` call, `debit(programs.len())`, checked total-type fold and its overflow/error order before applying the min. Do not substitute an unchecked/saturating total or skip that old work. Keep both traversals, all semantic checks, aliases, deduplication, sorting and work debits. Expected elimination: unused entry backing and its real reservation; allocation-call count is unchanged. Do not apply this bound to ownership facts, whose traversal can include other descendants.

Use complete independent old/current owning receivers with the same sources/cache state. Preserve all six diagnostic fields and ordering, canonical/source/graph bytes, existing semantic checks and declared work. Charge every genuine new control, backing and operation before acquisition under the actual owner; retain through Drop. No cap changes, refunds, quota reset, fee exemptions, baseline padding, skipped requirements or weakened tests.

Qualify in one focused implementation batch: actual total reservation, allocations/reallocations, allocated bytes and peak live through Drop; zero/one/multiple relevant cases; exact/one-short/zero work and byte limits; malformed/duplicate/interleaved cases; sticky, nested floor and foreign/restored/stale-owner controls as relevant. Run unchanged application owners and disclose failures; physical helper savings do not establish live-agent token gains. Regenerate moved pins using the actual producer; no full quality gates.

Related #754 owns private-layout feature admission, and #825 owns constructor failure propagation. This ticket is a distinct cold-success materialization optimization. Discovery source note is retained locally at `/Volumes/Semaprax/evidence/cold-construction-discovery-940fcf-4f8f598-20261015.md`; only the exact implementation fragments linked above are asserted to exist on the pushed commit.
title: (OPT) Bound private layout entry backing by its existing visit census
